en: Black‑and‑white riverside view showing a long, grand neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance waterfront complex with many pointed corner towers and dormers, fronted by a stone embankment. In the foreground are moored barges and a small rowing boat on a calm river, with sand or gravel piles, carts and scattered benches on the bank. Multi‑storey residential blocks continue to the left and right of the main complex. The architecture suggests a late‑19th‑century European city. No legible caption or postage markings are visible.
